## PDF page 220

[Open source PDF](../../../../sources/pdf/GTO/Poker-Math-Preflop-Workbook.pdf#page=220)

```text
                        FACING 4BETS


Now you will reverse the spot and be facing the 4bet.

Each page contains a single 4bet scenario. Read the prompt and then begin
by filling in the %-form for your 3betting range and two possible continuance
ranges.

Then fill out the table below for each 4bet size. Calculate both your folding
frequency and what the SPR would be if you called.

EXTRA CREDIT: When doing these exercises, come up with a situation or
assumption that would need to be true for you to use Range #1. Do the same
for Range #2. This is a valuable thought exercise that can produce multiple
valid answers. And even though the answer key does not give static answers
for these extra credit questions, it is still worth your time to consider them.

GLGL.




                                    PA G E 2 2 0
```
